_source.field_release_notes:
IQ Gateway software version 8.3.5433 provides product reliability and security improvements to Enphase Energy Systems with Solar Only configurations in the North American region.

Countries: Bermuda, Canada, Mexico, Puerto Rico and the United States.

 
#Feature classificationFeatureDescription
1Product reliabilityImprovements to IQ8 Microinverter reliabilityAdds enhancements to IQ8 Series Microinverter firmware to improve the long-term reliability of systems with these microinverters.
2Product reliabilityImprovements to Wi‑Fi configuration via Enphase App and Enphase Installer App

Improved Wi-Fi configuration experience via the Enphase App and via the Enphase Installer App.

  • Improved error messaging to streamline the Wi-Fi configuration process.
  • Expanded supported character set for Wi‑Fi credentials in the Enphase App and in the Enphase Installer App, enabling setup with additional languages and extended ASCII characters.
3Product securitySecurity improvementsImplements several security enhancements to the IQ Gateway software.

This release is deployed via remote software upgrades for systems with Solar Only configuration.

Gateways supported

  • Puerto Rico and the United States:
    • IQ Combiner 5/5C/4/4C/3/3C/3-ES/3C-ES, and IEEE 1547-2018 compliant IQ Combiner 4/4C
    • IQ Gateway and IEEE 1547-2018 compliant IQ Gateway
    • Envoy S Metered and Envoy S Standard
  • Bermuda and Mexico:
    • IQ Combiner 5/4 and IEEE 1547-2018 compliant IQ Combiner 4
    • IQ Gateway and IEEE 1547-2018 compliant IQ Gateway
  • Canada:
    • IQ Combiner 5
    • IQ Gateway and IEEE 1547-2018 compliant IQ Gateway

Microinverters supported

  • Puerto Rico and the United States:
    • IQ8 Series Microinverters
    • IQ7 Series Microinverters
    • IQ6 Series Microinverters
    • M Series Microinverters
    • S Series Microinverters
  • Bermuda, Canada, and Mexico:
    • IQ8 Series Microinverters
    • IQ7 Series Microinverters

System configurations supported

  • Puerto Rico and the United States:
    • Grid-tied (without backup) Solar Only systems with IQ8 Series Microinverters and IQ Combiner 5/5C or IEEE 1547-2018 compliant IQ Combiner 4/4C or IQ Combiner 4/4C/3/3C/3-ES/3C-ES or IEEE 1547-2018 compliant IQ Gateway or IQ Gateway
    • Grid-tied (without backup) Solar Only systems with IQ7 Series Microinverters and IQ Combiner 5/5C or IEEE 1547-2018 compliant IQ Combiner 4/4C or IQ Combiner 4/4C/3/3C/3-ES/3C-ES or IEEE 1547-2018 compliant IQ Gateway or IQ Gateway
    • Grid-tied (without backup) Solar Only systems with IQ6 Series Microinverters and IQ Combiner 5/5C/4/4C/3/3C/3-ES/3C-ES or IQ Gateway
    • Grid-tied (without backup) Solar Only systems with M Series or S Series Microinverters and Envoy S Metered for North America or Envoy S Standard for North America
  • Bermuda and Mexico:
    • Grid-tied (without backup) Solar Only systems with IQ7 Series Microinverters and IQ Combiner 4 or IQ Combiner 5 or IEEE 1547-2018 compliant IQ Gateway or IQ Gateway
    • Grid-tied (without backup) Solar Only systems with IQ8 Series Microinverters and IQ Combiner 4 or IQ Combiner 5 or IEEE 1547-2018 compliant IQ Gateway or IQ Gateway
  • Canada:
    • Grid-tied (without backup) Solar Only systems with IQ7 Series Microinverters and IQ Combiner 5 or IEEE 1547-2018 compliant IQ Gateway or IQ Gateway
    • Grid-tied (without backup) Solar Only systems with IQ8 Series Microinverters and IQ Combiner 5 or IEEE 1547-2018 compliant IQ Gateway or IQ Gateway

IQ Gateway software version 8.3.6087 improves product reliability and security for Enphase Energy Systems with 3rd-generation IQ Battery 5P in grid-tied and grid-forming configurations.

Countries: Bermuda, Canada, Mexico, Puerto Rico, and the United States.

 
#Feature classificationFeatureDescription
1Product reliabilityImprovements to battery State of Charge (SoC) calibration algorithmEnhances State of Charge (SoC) calibration algorithm in 3rd-generation Enphase Energy Systems with IQ Battery 5P.
2Product reliabilityImprovements to cell balancing algorithmEnhances the cell balancing algorithm in 3rd‑generation Enphase Energy Systems with IQ Battery 5P.
3Product reliabilityImprovements to Wi‑Fi configuration via Enphase App and Enphase Installer App

Improved Wi-Fi configuration experience via the Enphase App and the Enphase Installer App.

  • Improved error messaging to streamline the Wi-Fi configuration process.
  • Expanded supported character set for Wi‑Fi credentials in the Enphase App and the Enphase Installer App, enabling setup with additional languages and extended ASCII characters.
4Product reliabilityImprovements to cell modem connectivityAdds several improvements to enhance the connectivity of IQ Gateway to Enphase Cloud via the Mobile Connect.
5Product securitySecurity improvementsAdds security improvements to the IQ Gateway software.

This release is deployed via remote software upgrades for the supported configurations.
